newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT- ICTSI upgraded to "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- ICTSI upgraded to "buy".

text.p: Philippine brokerage firm Angping Securities said on Tuesday it has upgraded its recommendation on International Container Terminal Services Inc to "buy" from "long term buy".
"We are confident that ICTSI will meet our target of 417 million pesos for the year," said analyst Alexis Cabel.
Cabel said in a research paper distributed to the firm's clients that he expected ICTSI's two foreign subsidiaries in Argentina and Mexico to contribute more to the income of ICTSI in 1997.

Cost reduction due to automation at ICTSI's Manila International Container Terminal (MICT), and the start of the operation of the firm's Cabuyao inland container depot south of the capital in the first quarter next year would also boost the earnings of the firm, he added.
Recurring income of ICTSI in the first nine months of the year went up by 33 percent to 301 million pesos from the year-ago 226 million.
Cabel attributed higher income of ICTSI to brisk trade at the MICT.

"ICTSI's foreign subsidiaries also performed well in the first nine months. Terminal 5 in Argentina and Veracruz terminal in Mexico realised a net income of 16.9 million pesos from a 44.2 million loss last year," Cabel added.
